info.title: v2.returns.get_return_detail
info.description: Use this api to get detail information of a return by return sn.

get.description: Use this api to get detail information of a return by return sn.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

values:
<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/returns/get_return_detail?access_token=access_token&partner_id=partner_id&return_sn=2206150VT13E3MQ&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reason
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Indicates the original return reason submitted by the buyer when initiating the return request. Applicable values: See Data Definition- ReturnReason and Reassessed Request Reason. Note: There may be cases where Shopee Agent updates the return request with a "Reassessed Return Reason" after reviewing more details about the buyer's return request and potentially after requesting evidence from the seller. If the platform updates the return reason during this process, the reassessed outcome will be provided separately in the reassessed_request_reason field.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reassessed_request_reason

There may be cases where Shopee Agent updates the return request with a "Reassessed Return Reason" after reviewing more details about the buyer's return request and potentially after requesting evidence from the seller. Applicable values: See Data Definition- ReturnReason and Reassessed Request Reason. If no reassessment has been made, the value will be NONE.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate the reverse logistics status. See "Data Definition - LogisticsStatus". Note: - This is a legacy field that only reflects the reverse logistics status of Normal RR. To determine whether the RR is a Normal RR, check if return_refund_request_type = 0. - If you need the reverse logistics status for Normal RR, In-transit RR, or Return-on-the-Spot, please use the newly released field reverse_logistic_status instead.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reverse_logistics_status

See "Data Definition - ReverseLogisticsStatus" as status displayed for Normal RR and In-transit RR or Return-on-the-Spot are different.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: whs_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate the warehouse id where item will be returned to. Please call v2.shop.get_warehouse_detail to check the detailed warehouse information the item returned to with the field "location_id" of the v2.shop.get_warehouse_detail match to the field"whs_id"of the v2.return.get_return_detail. For fulfillment by Shopee (FBS) & multi warehouse sellers, R/R orders will be returned back to the nearest warehouse of buyer address instead of going back to only 1 default return address like a normal seller.If it's a normal seller, then the field will be response empty.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_refund_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether the return is RRBOC (Return/Refund request raised before Order Complete) or RRAOC (Return/Refund request raised after Order Complete).

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_solution
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate the most updated solution of the Return/Refund request (NOTE: this is not the solution during negotiation). Applicable value: - 0: Return and Refund - 1: Refund Only

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_seller_arrange
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether the return_sn is using the “Seller Arrange” return method. This would only be True for TW and BR.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_shipping_proof_mandatory
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether uploading shipping proof is mandatory for seller to confirm "Arrange Pickup" when is_seller_arrange = true.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: has_uploaded_shipping_proof
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether seller has already uploaded shipping proof for this return.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_reverse_logistics_channel_integrated
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether the reverse logistic channel type selected is integrated or non-integrated.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: reverse_logistics_channel_name
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate reverse logistic carrier name.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: return_refund_request_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate the type of return refund request, whether it is a Normal RR request, an In-transit RR request, and a Return on the Spot: 0: Normal RR (RR is raised by the buyer after delivery done / estimated delivery date) 1: In-transit RR (RR is raised by the buyer while item is still in-transit to buyer) 2: Return-on-the-Spot (RR is raised by the driver after buyer rejected parcel at delivery) For more details, see Data Definition- Return Refund Request Type.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: validation_type
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: To indicate whether seller or warehouse will expect to receive the return parcel from buyer and validate the condition of the parcel: - seller_validation - warehouse_validation For more details, see Data Definition- ValidationType.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: is_arrived_at_warehouse
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: [Only for validation_type = warehouse_validation] Indicates the parcel’s check-in status at the warehouse. This field helps sellers quickly determine whether the parcel has arrived at the warehouse or has been rejected. Applicable values: 1: Pending Inbound 2: Rejected 3: Inbound 4: Cancelled

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: follow_up_action_list
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: [Only for validation_type = warehouse_validation] Warehouse handling actions for each item in the parcel.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: item_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Unique identifier of the item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: model_id
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Unique identifier of the model under the item.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: qty
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Quantity of items or models under the same current status.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: current_status
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Current status for the item/model within the warehouse. Applicable values: 1：Dispose 2：Return to Seller 7：Received and Putaway 8：Return to Buyer 9：Shortage Note: Since Resell is currently applicable only to Failed Delivery parcels, the following values will not be returned for now, and will be returned once Resell becomes applicable to Return Refund parcels in the future: 3：Putaway for Resell 4：Resell Outbound 5：Resell Failed 6：Resell Exit

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: related_order_sn_list
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: List of order_sn generated from the Resell process. Returned only when current_status = 4 (Resell Outbound). Note: Since Resell is currently applicable only to Failed Delivery parcels, this field will remain empty for now, and valid values will be returned once Resell becomes applicable to Return Refund parcels in the future.

x-shopee-response-parameters.Name: resell_failed_next_step
x-shopee-response-parameters.Description: Next step after a Resell failure. Returned only when current_status = 5 (Resell Failed). Note: Since Resell is currently applicable only to Failed Delivery parcels, this field will remain empty for now, and valid values will be returned once Resell becomes applicable to Return Refund parcels in the future.
